value.rationale: The enumerated objects are freely reduced spellings, not relator-reduced group elements: relations such as \(a^p\)=1 and \(b^q\)=1 make many length-9/10 witnesses equivalent to much shorter words, so the cutoff L=10 and word counts are presentation-spelling artifacts rather than a natural length-spectrum invariant. Together with the arbitrary small parameter box p,q,r<=6, this makes the table a routine bounded enumeration without a sufficiently motivated mathematical boundary. Correctness and novelty alone do not establish value.
